product.description: Lui Jane Marple nu-i vine să-şi creadă ochilor atunci când citeşte scrisoarea care îi fusese adresată de recent decedatul domn Rafiel – o cunoştință pe care o întâlnise fugitiv în călătoria din Caraibe. Şi totuşi, acesta îi lăsase instrucțiuni ca, după moartea lui, Miss Marple să investigheze o infracțiune. Singura problemă este că a omis să-i spună cine era implicat şi când anume fusese comisă fapta – lucru care o nedumereşte pe Miss Marple, dar îi stârneşte şi curiozitatea. Curând însă, Jane Marple trebuie să se confrunte cu cea mai violentă dintre infracțiuni – crima –, căci, se pare, cineva este foarte interesat ca trecutul să rămână îngropat pentru totdeauna...   Cărți traduse în peste 100 de limbi Peste 2 miliarde de exemplare vândute

# Nemesis by Litera - A Classic Mystery Novel

Step into a world of suspense with *Nemesis* from Litera. This captivating piece of fiction draws readers deep into an intricate mystery, featuring the beloved sleuth Miss Jane Marple. If you are looking for a classic whodunit filled with secrets and danger, this novel promises an unforgettably gripping reading experience.

## The Mystery Begins: An Unsolvable Crime

Miss Jane Marple thought she had seen it all, but nothing prepared her for the cryptic letter that arrives in her hands. This mysterious correspondence is from the recently deceased Mr. Rafielâa man with whom she encountered during a fleeting trip to the Caribbean.

The letter contains instructions: Miss Marple must investigate a crime committed following his death. However, the message leaves out two critical details, plunging Jane into immediate confusion and curiosity: who was involved in the incident, and when exactly did it take place?

## Unraveling the Truth of Nemesis

As Jane begins her investigation, she finds herself confronting more than just a cold case. She must navigate dangerous circumstances as seemingly someone has an intense interest in keeping certain past secrets buried forever. *Nemesis* builds tension with every page, forcing Miss Marple to confront a violent and deeply personal crime that threatens to unravel the lives of everyone involved.

This novel is a perfect journey for fans of classic mystery fiction who enjoy complex plots and brilliant deductive reasoning. Discover how Jane uses her sharp wit to uncover the truth in *Nemesis*.
